entries.reason: `IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after `EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK RESP(WS-CICS-RESP)` (565-568). IBM documents one condition for it (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-syncpoint-rollback): INVREQ RESP2 200, raised when the program was linked to from a remote system that did not specify SYNCONRETURN, or was linked locally and is defined EXECUTIONSET(DPLSUBSET). BANK.csd defines DBCRFUN with EXECUTIONSET(FULLAPI), and the harness LINKs it locally. Assumption to review: a remote caller (the z/OS Connect Pay service) links with SYNCONRETURN; the harness plans no fault on SYNCPOINT. The paragraphs behind this arm and behind HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-HANDLING) stay uncovered, as this ledger states branches, not paragraphs.
